text: The authors state that the user's decomposition of task evaluation into simpler assistance tasks, combined into an aggregated evaluation, must be exhaustive, because if one aspect of the task outcome is neglected the new agent may optimise it in an arbitrary, undesirable direction. They add that this is another problem they hope to solve with recursive reward modeling.
title: Evaluation decomposition must be exhaustive
